title: Portable Local Staging Auto Pilot, Tunnel, OAuth, and Database Isolation

phases.objective: Provide a portable Windows/External-SSD Staging topology with fail-closed environment isolation, local three-database readiness, loopback-only origin exposure, health-gated Cloudflare ingress, and environment-aware OAuth/MCP/OpenAPI discovery.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging operator and governed runtime verifier
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Start-AutoPilot.ps1 and Staging runtime contract suite
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The verifier proves that Staging uses only dev.mad4b.com and mcp_dev.mad4b.com, rejects Production and activation_dev hostnames, keeps origins loopback/local-network isolated, requires healthy Redis/API/three MariaDB services before tunnel startup, rejects unsafe or duplicate env values, and exposes no secrets in generated OpenAPI or bounded evidence.
steps: Load the Staging policy, env template, Compose overlay, OpenAPI artifact, Auto Pilot, and database-copy contracts.
Verify the two active tunnel hostnames and the reserved-disabled activation_dev hostname against the domain-family policy.
Verify that the remote MCP resource uses mcp_dev.mad4b.com and that Tenant GPT OAuth uses the dedicated Staging client namespace and dev.mad4b.com issuer/resource.
Verify that the generated Staging OAuth preset points to openapi.tenant-gpt.staging.yaml, has no activation schema, and returns 404 on mcp_dev and activation_dev discovery hosts.
Verify that Compose binds the origin to loopback, keeps Redis unexposed, gates cloudflared on app health, and requires health status rather than HTTP 200 alone.
Verify that Auto Pilot and database cloning enforce WSL2 presence, local Docker context, valid Compose model, healthy services, duplicate-key rejection, and mutation flags read from .env.staging.

Verify the manifest hashes the complete Staging operational scope while migration_applied, database_mutated, production_deploy, provider_mutation, cloudflare_dns_mutation, and hostinger_mutation remain false.
assertions: Staging active hostnames are exactly dev.mad4b.com and mcp_dev.mad4b.com.
activation_dev.mad4b.com and all Production hostnames are excluded from Staging OAuth, MCP, DNS, and tunnel contracts.
The Staging OpenAPI artifact server, OAuth URLs, schema_url, scope links, and boundary metadata use dev.mad4b.com; activation_schema_url is empty.
The runtime discovery endpoint returns the Staging preset only for dev.mad4b.com and returns 404 for mcp_dev.mad4b.com and activation_dev.mad4b.com.
No raw OAuth, tunnel, database, JWT, or MCP secret is included in policy, OpenAPI, manifest, or test evidence.
The API and Redis are not LAN-published, and cloudflared depends on app health.
Database cloning remains schema_only by default and rejects unsafe production/provider paths and non-local Docker contexts.
The manifest safety flags remain false and the operational file scope is hash-protected.
Canonical operation keys use dot notation and Brand context read is declared read-only and shadow-only.
Brand create exposes a bounded next_operations array whose entries require operation_key, status, and reason without activating a write.
Canonical parity performance gates report zero known-intent list-tools calls, zero mutations without expected revision/readback, and zero hard-delete operations without dependency plans.
Frontend governance and surface dispatch generated artifacts are regenerated from the changed Brand route/lifecycle source and pass deterministic check.
A push to main is eligible for local Staging only after the exact SHA passes the Staging Main Deploy Eligibility check.
The Windows watcher refuses missing, running, or failed eligibility checks and never deploys the same SHA twice.
Task Scheduler installation uses the interactive Windows user and does not expose an inbound webhook or store deployment secrets.
Auto Deploy policy and workflow contain no Production hostnames or secrets and keep all mutation safety flags false.
Auto Pilot and Auto Deploy runtime state files are ignored so a prior deployment does not make the Git worktree dirty.
Tenant and Admin Staging Custom GPT schemas are independent documents with one server URI each; Remote MCP has a separate mcp_dev protocol document.
dev.mad4b.com exposes Tenant and Admin schema variants while mcp_dev.mad4b.com exposes only the independent Remote MCP schema; cross-surface schema requests return 404.
The Staging Admin schema is GET-only and the Remote MCP schema keeps write activation false.

The one-click Windows launcher bootstraps Git, GitHub CLI, Docker Desktop, WSL2, local secrets, CI eligibility, Staging startup, optional schema-only seed, and Task Scheduler without Production or provider mutation.
Missing Cloudflare credentials are requested only inside the launcher and are stored only in ignored local environment state; no secret is committed or included in evidence.

Auto Pilot, Auto Deploy, and application operations write redacted durable JSONL events plus latest-status and last-failure snapshots on the External SSD, and the CMD launcher exposes the log path after failure.
The Health Monitor writes a per-component heartbeat and health-snapshot.json, checks only local Docker services, and is installed and removed together with the Auto Deploy Task Scheduler task.
Operations logs use a run_id for correlation and rotate bounded JSONL files without changing Production or provider state.

Staging-Doctor exposes Status, Repair, and Logs modes; Repair may recreate local scheduled tasks and rotate logs, but cannot delete data, apply migrations, rewrite secrets, touch Production, mutate Cloudflare DNS, or mutate Hostinger.

phases.objective: Run the portable Staging stack on the operator's Windows 10 host, validate WSL2/Docker/NTFS behavior, provision local schemas, and establish the Cloudflare connector without importing Production data or credentials.
blockers: The Windows host has not yet run the authoritative PowerShell -ValidateOnly preflight.
The operator must supply the dedicated Staging OAuth client secret and Cloudflare tunnel token manually in the ignored local env file.
Docker Desktop, WSL2 integration, the three local MariaDB services, Redis, and the API have not been executed in this Linux sandbox.
Schema provisioning requires an operator-reviewed local dump directory and explicit Apply authorization.

phases.objective: Add repeatable local backup/restore drills, connector reconnection checks, and device-migration verification without copying Production credentials or unsanitized data.
No external provider write canary or Production traffic canary is introduced by this local Staging change.
Production remains on Hostinger and is outside this local Staging delivery.
blockers: No Hostinger deployment, Production database mutation, Production OAuth change, or Production Cloudflare DNS change is authorized by this contract.
Production readiness is not inferred from local Staging success.
